name: com.pushizo/mcp
title: Pushizo
description: Push, email, SMS, in-app and journeys. 73 tools: reads and drafts; only test sends.

environmentVariables.name: PUSHIZO_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Pushizo API key (hs_live_…). segments:read, analytics:read, users:read for reads; mcp:write for drafts and test sends

environmentVariables.name: PUSHIZO_APP_ID
environmentVariables.description: Default app id (app_…) when a tool call omits app_id
